textareaHits.text: /** Preserve exact plain-message expectations across textarea and paragraph editors. */

manualClassifications.disposition: Existing expectMailMessage helper preserves exact plain-message text across textarea or paragraph editor. No direct Message value assertion remains.
Message uses fill(), which supports contenteditable; Cc/Subject value assertions refer to actual input elements.
message(page) alias resolves role=textbox name=Message; expectations use text/child markup/innerHTML, not input value.
HTMLTextAreaElement branch is guarded and has paragraph-text fallback; not a textarea-only assumption.
Only direct textarea locator is the independent Meeting context textarea CSS-height check, not Mail.
Remaining .value accesses are fixture records, integration probe input or watchlist terms; not Mail Message element value reads.

scopeLimit: Static tracked-source search plus manual call-site/alias review. Does not replace browser execution or prove every dynamic selector.
